items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: So we left Birdland and we went on tour with Basie and Sarah and all that.

ctx.x: Yeah, a package deal. We were in Birdland with Count Basie. So we left Birdland and we went on tour with Basie and Sarah and all that. Then we got a deal to go to San Francisco, at the Black Hawk, and that did it. One of the famous photographers -- what was his name? He was fantastic. One of the most famous at that time. Well, anyway, he took pictures of us and put us in the leading paper in San Francisco.
